title: varifolds
summary: General theory of k-varifolds on open subsets of smooth Riemannian manifolds, in the generality of Allard and Simon's Chapter 8: Grassmann bundle in projection form, varifold carrier and convergence, rectifiable and integral varifolds, push-forward and blow-ups, first variation and its Riesz decomposition, comparison of first variations under change of metric, smooth and embedded comparisons, Euclidean and intrinsic Riemannian monotonicity, densities, constancy, Allard's rectifiability theorem, compactness for rectifiable and integral varifolds under C^2 convergence of metrics, varifold tangents and tangent cones, regular and singular sets, and the comparison with GeometricCurrents G6's auxiliary varifold.

layers.title: The Grassmann bundle and the varifold carrier

targets.name: Varifolds.grassmannian
targets.statement: For a finite-dimensional real inner product space E and 0 <= k <= dim E, G(E,k) is the set of self-adjoint idempotent continuous linear maps of E with k-dimensional range, with the operator-norm metric; S -> P_S is a bijection from k-dimensional subspaces onto G(E,k).
hypotheses: E finite-dimensional real inner product space

api.name: isCompact
api.statement: G(E,k) is compact; every element has norm at most 1, equal to 1 when k >= 1.

api.name: complement
api.statement: P -> 1 - P is a homeomorphism G(E,k) -> G(E, dim E - k); tr P = k.

api.name: isometry action
api.statement: a surjective linear isometry U: E -> F gives the homeomorphism P -> U P U^{-1} of G(E,k) onto G(F,k), functorial in U; any linear isometry U gives P -> U P U*, a homeomorphism of G(E,k) onto the closed set of projections in G(F,k) with range in range U; for k >= 1 this set is all of G(F,k) only when U is surjective, for k = 0 both sides are {0}.

api.name: tangential trace
api.statement: P -> tr(P A) is continuous and linear with |tr(P A)| <= k ||A||.

api.name: image plane
api.statement: for finite-dimensional inner product spaces E, F, the pairs (L,P) with L: E -> F linear and injective on range P form an open set, on which the projection onto L(range P) in G(F,k) depends continuously on (L,P); with Q = L P it is Q (Q*Q + 1 - P)^{-1} Q*. L need not be injective on E.

tests.name: dist lines
tests.statement: ||P_{l_theta} - P_{l_0}|| = |sin theta| for lines of R^2; perpendicular lines are at distance 1 (Frobenius would give sqrt 2).

tests.name: degenerate ranks
tests.statement: G(E,0) = {0} and G(E,dim E) = {1}.

tests.name: idempotent non-example
tests.statement: [[1,t],[0,0]] is idempotent, not self-adjoint, so not in G(R^2,1); including such maps would destroy compactness.

tests.name: rank
tests.statement: diag(1,1,0) lies in G(R^3,2), not in G(R^3,1), and has trace 2.

tests.name: image plane boundary
tests.statement: for L_s = diag(1,s) and lines l_theta the image line tends to l_0 along s = 0 and to l_{pi/2} along theta = pi/2, so there is no continuous extension at (diag(1,0), P_{l_{pi/2}}); diag(1,0) is injective on l_0, A = 1 and the projection there is P_{l_0}.

tests.name: isometric inclusion
tests.statement: the inclusion t -> (t,0) of R into R^2 is a non-surjective linear isometry: G(R,1) = {1} goes to diag(1,0) only, P_{l_{pi/2}} = diag(0,1) is missed and U^{-1} does not exist; a rotation of R^2 conjugates l_theta to l_{theta+phi} and reaches every line. For k = 0 the same U maps G(R,0) = {0} onto G(R^2,0) = {0}: the image is everything though U is not surjective.

targets.name: Varifolds.GrassmannBundle
targets.statement: G_k(W) is the set of pairs (x,P) with x in W and P in G(T_xM,k) for g_x, topologised as a subspace of the total space of the endomorphism bundle; pi(x,P) = x. It is homeomorphic over W to GeometricCurrents G6's unoriented Grassmann bundle via S -> P_S; pi is proper with fibres G(T_xM,k).
hypotheses: (M,g) smooth Riemannian, Hausdorff, second countable, boundaryless

api.name: proper projection
api.statement: pi is continuous, open and proper; G_k(K) is compact for compact K; G_k(W) is locally compact, Hausdorff, second countable, metrizable.

api.name: trivialisation
api.statement: an orthonormal frame on U gives G_k(U) = U x G(R^N,k) over U; G_k(W') is open for open W'.

api.name: G6 comparison
api.statement: S -> (x,P_S) is a homeomorphism from G6's bundle onto G_k(W) commuting with projections.

api.name: isometries
api.statement: an isometry f of an open set of (M,g) onto an open set of (M',g') (C^1 diffeomorphism with f*g' = g, each df_x a surjective linear isometry) induces (x,P) -> (f x, df P df^{-1}).

api.name: change of metric
api.statement: for metrics g,h the canonical homeomorphism sends P^g_S to P^h_S; identity for h = c^2 g.

tests.name: lines of R^2
tests.statement: G_1(W) = W x RP^1 for W open in R^2.

tests.name: degenerate
tests.statement: k = 0 and k = N give bundles identified with W.

tests.name: metric dependence
tests.statement: for h = diag(1,4) and u = (1,1) the h-projection sends e_1 to u/5, the Euclidean one to u/2.

tests.name: compact sphere
tests.statement: G_1(S^2) is compact although TS^2 is nontrivial.

targets.name: Varifolds.Varifold
targets.statement: A k-varifold on W is a Radon measure V on G_k(W); its weight is pi_*V, its mass V(G_k(W)), its support the support of the weight; V restricted to A is V on G_k(A).

api.name: cone
api.statement: varifolds form a cone; Dirac varifolds have Dirac weights.

api.name: ext
api.statement: varifolds agreeing on all compactly supported continuous functions are equal.

api.name: weight integral
api.statement: integral of phi against the weight equals integral of phi o pi against V.

api.name: carried by support
api.statement: V(G_k(W minus spt||V||)) = 0.

api.name: restriction
api.statement: restriction to open sets is transitive, local and commutes with weights.

tests.name: weight not determining
tests.statement: horizontal and vertical lifts of H^1 on the x-axis have equal weights and differ on chi(x) tr(P diag(1,0)).

tests.name: mass of a line
tests.statement: the horizontal lift of H^1 on the x-axis has mass 2 on the unit disc.

tests.name: degenerate
tests.statement: V restricted to the empty set is 0; spt of a Dirac varifold at x is {x}.

targets.name: Varifolds.Varifold.Tendsto
targets.statement: V_j -> V when the integrals of every compactly supported continuous function on G_k(W) converge; every sequence with locally bounded mass has a convergent subsequence.

api.name: weights
api.statement: convergence of varifolds implies convergence of weights.

api.name: portmanteau
api.statement: lim sup on compact sets <= limit; lim inf on open sets >= limit; convergence on continuity sets.

api.name: local bound
api.statement: a convergent sequence has locally bounded mass.

api.name: compactness
api.statement: locally bounded mass implies a convergent subsequence (G6 Radon compactness).

api.name: locality
api.statement: convergence commutes with restriction to open sets and is local.

tests.name: moving Dirac
tests.statement: delta_{(1/j,P)} -> delta_{(0,P)}.

tests.name: escaping mass
tests.statement: delta_{(j e_1,P)} -> 0 on R^N; masses 1, limit 0.

tests.name: alternating planes
tests.statement: alternating horizontal and vertical lifts of the same weight have no limit.

tests.name: unbounded mass
tests.statement: j delta_{(0,P)} has no convergent subsequence.

targets.name: Varifolds.HasApproxTangentSpace
targets.statement: A Radon measure mu on W has approximate tangent space T with multiplicity theta in (0,inf) at x when lambda^{-k} mu(exp_x(lambda .)) -> theta H^k on T vaguely; if this holds mu-a.e., the set of such points is countably k-rectifiable and mu = theta H^k restricted to it, and conversely.

api.name: criterion
api.statement: a.e. approximate tangent spaces imply mu = theta H^k on a countably rectifiable set (Simon 11.8).

api.name: converse
api.statement: theta H^k on a countably rectifiable set has approximate tangent spaces a.e.

api.name: chart comparison
api.statement: mu has (T,theta) at x iff phi_* mu has (dphi_x T, theta / J_T dphi_x) at phi(x).

api.name: uniqueness
api.statement: approximate tangent space and multiplicity are unique.

tests.name: line
tests.statement: H^1 on the x-axis has multiplicity 1; 2 H^1 has multiplicity 2; since mu(x + lambda B_1(0)) = 2 lambda on L, a lambda^{-k+1} normalisation would give multiplicity 0 and a lambda^{-k-1} normalisation would give 2/lambda -> inf (divergent blow-ups).

tests.name: Lebesgue
tests.statement: Lebesgue measure on R^2 with k = 1 has no approximate tangent line.

tests.name: Dirac
tests.statement: delta_0 with k = 1 has blow-up mass lambda^{-1} -> inf.

tests.name: chart scaling
tests.statement: for phi = 2 id, phi_* H^1 on L = 1/2 H^1 on L, multiplicity 1/2.

targets.name: Varifolds.rectifiableVarifold
targets.statement: v(Gamma,theta) integrates 1_A(x,T_x Gamma) theta dH^k over Gamma; rectifiable varifolds are those of this form and integral ones have integer theta a.e.

api.name: weight
api.statement: ||v(Gamma,theta)|| = theta H^k on Gamma; mass is the integral of theta.

api.name: null modification
api.statement: v is unchanged by H^k-null changes of Gamma and theta.

api.name: additivity
api.statement: sums and restrictions of rectifiable varifolds.

api.name: characterisation
api.statement: V rectifiable iff its weight is theta H^k on a rectifiable set and V lifts it by tangent planes.

api.name: k = 0
api.statement: v(Gamma,theta) = sum theta(x) delta_{(x,0)} for countable Gamma.

tests.name: half multiplicity
tests.statement: v(L,1/2) is rectifiable, not integral.

tests.name: countable set
tests.statement: for k >= 1 and countable Gamma, v = 0.

tests.name: Lebesgue lift
tests.statement: Lebesgue measure lifted with a constant line is not rectifiable.

targets.name: Varifolds.submanifoldVarifold
targets.statement: [Sigma] = v(Sigma,1) for a C^1 embedded k-submanifold Sigma of W with locally finite area (possibly non-compact, non-orientable, not closed); its tangent planes are the classical ones and its weight H^k restricted to Sigma is the Riemannian volume of Sigma for the continuous induced metric (this roadmap's chart comparison).
hypotheses: Sigma C^1 embedded k-submanifold of W, H^k(Sigma cap K) < inf for compact K

api.name: tangent planes
api.statement: the approximate tangent plane is T_x Sigma at every point.

api.name: weight
api.statement: weight equals the Riemannian volume of Sigma with the induced continuous metric: by eq_riemannianVolume_iff compare on small chart sources, GMT G2 area formula (injective case) for the chart parametrisation, GeometricCurrents G2 chart comparison of H^k for d_g, normDet_comp; agrees with GeometricCurrents G2's mass of a compact oriented smooth source.

api.name: support
api.statement: spt is the closure of Sigma in W; disjoint unions add.

tests.name: circle
tests.statement: the unit circle gives mass 2 pi.

tests.name: C1 graph
tests.statement: graph of |t|^{3/2} over (-1,1): induced metric (1 + (9/4)|t|) dt^2, H^1(Sigma) = integral of sqrt(1 + (9/4)|t|) = (26 sqrt 13 - 16)/27 ~ 2.879 > 2 sqrt 2; non-compact, C^1 not C^2.

tests.name: half-line
tests.statement: the open half-line has support the closed half-line.

tests.name: figure eight
tests.statement: the figure-eight image is not embedded, so [.] is undefined, while v(image,1) exists.

targets.name: Varifolds.Varifold.pushforward
targets.statement: For f: W -> W' of class C^1, proper on spt||V||, f_#V(A) = integral of 1_A(f x, df_x S) J_S f(x) dV(x,S), with J_S f = normDet(df_x restricted to S).

api.name: weight formula
api.statement: ||f_#V||(A) = integral over pi^{-1} f^{-1} A of J_S f dV; spt ||f_#V|| subset f(spt ||V||).

api.name: functoriality
api.statement: id_# = id and (h o f)_# = h_# f_# (chain rule for J).

api.name: isometry
api.statement: for an isometry f of W onto W', J = 1 and f_# is the measure push-forward along 1.2's homeomorphism; for an isometric immersion, J = 1 and f_# is the measure push-forward along (x,P) -> (f x, df P df*).

api.name: continuity
api.statement: f_# preserves convergence on sets where f is uniformly proper.

api.name: rectifiable
api.statement: f_# v(Gamma,theta) = v(f(Gamma+), fibre sum of theta); integral to integral.

tests.name: homothety
tests.statement: f = 2 id maps v([0,1]x{0},1) to v([0,2]x{0},1) of mass 2.

tests.name: projection
tests.statement: f(y) = (y1,0) kills a vertical segment: f_#V = 0.

tests.name: non-proper
tests.statement: collapsing infinitely many vertical segments gives infinite mass: properness is needed.

targets.name: Varifolds.Varifold.blowUp
targets.statement: V_{x,lambda} = (eta_{x,lambda})_# V in E and (lambda^{-1} exp_x^{-1})_# (V on a normal ball) on M, a varifold on (T_xM, g_x).
hypotheses: normal ball of x inside W

api.name: scaling law
api.statement: ||V_{x,lambda}||(A) = lambda^{-k} ||V||(x + lambda A) in E; composition of dilations.

api.name: normal coordinates
api.statement: ||V_{x,lambda}||(B_rho(0)) = lambda^{-k}(1+o(1)) ||V||(B_{lambda rho}(x)).

api.name: continuity
api.statement: V -> V_{x,lambda} preserves convergence, sums, restriction.

tests.name: segment
tests.statement: v([0,1]x{0},1) blows up to v([0,1/lambda]x{0},1) of mass 1/lambda.

tests.name: line through x
tests.statement: a line through x is fixed by all blow-ups.

tests.name: great circle
tests.statement: on S^2 a great circle through x has ||V_{x,lambda}||(B_rho(0)) = 2 rho exactly.

tests.name: missing factor
tests.statement: omitting lambda^{-k} would keep the mass of a segment constant.

targets.name: Varifolds.Varifold.HasTangentSpace
targets.statement: V has tangent space T with multiplicity theta at x when V_{x,lambda} -> theta v(T,1); fibre measures nu^x disintegrate V over its weight; if tangent spaces with multiplicity exist ||V||-a.e. then V = v(Gamma,theta) (first rectifiability theorem).

api.name: weight tangent
api.statement: a tangent space of V is an approximate tangent space of ||V|| (Simon 38.2).

api.name: fibre measures
api.statement: x -> nu^x probability measures with V = integral of delta_x x nu^x d||V||; ball averages converge a.e. (E, Besicovitch) and at ||V||-a.e. point of the positive finite density set D (M, Vitali family on the geodesic density points of D).

api.name: first rectifiability
api.statement: a.e. tangent spaces imply V = v(Gamma,theta) (Simon 38.3).

api.name: converse
api.statement: rectifiable varifolds have tangent spaces a.e.

tests.name: crossing lines
tests.statement: two crossing lines have no tangent space at 0 but one elsewhere.

tests.name: Lebesgue lift
tests.statement: Lebesgue measure with a constant line has blow-up masses pi lambda -> 0: no tangent space.

tests.name: vertical lift
tests.statement: the vertical lift of H^1 on an axis has weight tangents but no varifold tangent space.

tests.name: line
tests.statement: nu^x = delta_{P_L} for v(L,1).

targets.name: Varifolds.Varifold.firstVariation
targets.statement: div_S X = tr(P_S nabla X) with the Levi-Civita connection; deltaV(X) = integral of div_S X dV for C^1 compactly supported X; t -> ||(phi_t)_# V||(K) is differentiable with derivative deltaV(X) at 0 for the flow phi_t of X and compact K containing spt X.
hypotheses: X C^1 with compact support in W
K compact, spt X subset K

api.name: linearity and bound
api.statement: deltaV is linear in X, additive in V, |deltaV(X)| <= k ||V||(K) sup |nabla X|.

api.name: locality
api.statement: deltaV(X) = 0 if X vanishes on an open set containing spt||V|| cap spt X; restriction to open sets.

api.name: continuity
api.statement: V_j -> V implies deltaV_j(X) -> deltaV(X).

api.name: degenerate dimensions
api.statement: delta = 0 for k = 0; deltaV(X) = integral of div X for k = N.

api.name: derivative of mass
api.statement: the flow derivative formula (Simon 39, Agnoletto Prop 2.6).

tests.name: circle dilation
tests.statement: for the unit circle and X = psi y, deltaV(X) = 2 pi = d/dt 2 pi e^t at 0.

tests.name: normal translation
tests.statement: a normal translation field has zero first variation on a line.

tests.name: volume
tests.statement: for k = N and V = vol, deltaV = 0 (divergence theorem).

tests.name: support dependence
tests.statement: the vertical lift of H^1 on an axis has deltaV(X) != 0 for some X vanishing on the support.

targets.name: Varifolds.rieszRepresentation_vectorField
targets.statement: A linear functional L on compactly supported continuous vector fields on W with local sup bounds is integration of a unit field eta against a unique Radon measure ||L||, with ||L||(U) = sup{L(X): |X| <= 1, spt X subset U}. On a frame domain ||L|| is the chart image of Tau Ceti's Distribution.massMeasure of the frame-coordinate functional (C^0 tests, Euclidean norm); the polar field and the gluing over W are built here.
hypotheses: local bounds sup{L(X): |X| <= 1, spt X subset K} < inf for compact K

tests.name: Dirac
tests.statement: L(X) = <X(0),v>: for v != 0, ||L|| = |v| delta_0 and eta(0) = v/|v| (v = 2e_1 gives 2 delta_0 and e_1); for v = 0, L = 0, ||L|| = 0 and eta is unconstrained on the null set, so eta is unique only ||L||-a.e.

tests.name: cancellation
tests.statement: two cancelling terms give ||L|| = 0.

tests.name: Euclidean norm
tests.statement: L(X) = integral of X^1 + X^2 gives sqrt 2 Lebesgue, not 2 Lebesgue: the mass-measure supremum on U is sqrt 2 vol(U) with EuclideanSpace-valued tests, and would be 2 vol(U) with the sup norm of Fin 2 -> R.

targets.name: Varifolds.Varifold.IsStationary
targets.statement: V is stationary if deltaV = 0; V has locally bounded first variation if |deltaV(X)| <= C_K sup|X| for spt X subset K; then ||deltaV|| (from 4.2) is Radon with the open-set sup formula and is lower semicontinuous under convergence.

api.name: extension
api.statement: deltaV extends to continuous compactly supported fields.

api.name: support
api.statement: spt ||deltaV|| subset spt ||V||; deltaV(X) depends only on X on spt||V||; subadditivity, homogeneity, restriction.

api.name: lower semicontinuity
api.statement: ||deltaV||(U) <= lim inf ||deltaV_j||(U); stationarity passes to limits.

tests.name: line
tests.statement: a line is stationary; the unit circle has ||delta|| = H^1 on it.

tests.name: vertical lift
tests.statement: the vertical lift of H^1 on an axis is not of locally bounded first variation.

tests.name: constant plane
tests.statement: Lebesgue measure with a constant line and the volume (k = N) are stationary.

targets.name: Varifolds.Varifold.firstVariation_eq_riesz
targets.statement: For locally bounded first variation, deltaV(X) = -integral <H_V,X> d||V|| + integral <eta_V,X> d sigma_V with H_V in L^1_loc, sigma_V = ||deltaV|| on a ||V||-null set, |eta_V| = 1; stationary iff H_V = 0 and sigma_V = 0; laws for isometries onto open sets and for dilations.
hypotheses: V of locally bounded first variation in W

api.name: uniqueness
api.statement: H_V, sigma_V, eta_V unique a.e.

api.name: bounded mean curvature
api.statement: |H_V| <= Lambda and sigma_V = 0 iff |deltaV(X)| <= Lambda integral |X| d||V||.

api.name: dilations
api.statement: delta(V_{x,lambda})(Y) = lambda^{1-k} deltaV(Y o eta), H scales by lambda.

tests.name: half hyperplane
tests.statement: H = 0, sigma = H^{N-2} on the edge, eta = -e_1.

tests.name: variable multiplicity
tests.statement: v(L,1+y_1^2) has tangential H = (theta'/theta) e_1.

tests.name: sphere
tests.statement: H_{[S^k]} = -k x; dilated circle has |H| = lambda/R.

targets.name: Varifolds.firstVariation_metric_comparison
targets.statement: For metrics g,h on a chart Omega, compact K and V for g, |delta_h V^h(X) - delta_g V(X)| <= C(||h-g||_{C^0} sup|DX| + ||h-g||_{C^1} sup|X|) ||V||(K); in normal coordinates the blow-ups V_{x,lambda} satisfy |delta_{g_x} V_{x,lambda}(Y)| <= lambda^{1-k}||deltaV||(B_{lambda R}(x)) sup|Y| + C lambda (sup|Y| + sup|DY|) lambda^{-k} ||V||(B_{lambda R}(x)).

tests.name: conformal constant
tests.statement: h = c^2 g gives |c^k - 1| |delta_g V(X)|; for the flat metric g = e this is at most k|c^k - 1| sup|DX| ||V||(K).

tests.name: derivative term
tests.statement: a Dirac varifold and X = psi A y show the sup|DX| term is necessary.

tests.name: great circle
tests.statement: blow-ups of a great circle on S^2 are lines with zero Euclidean first variation.

tests.name: connection term
tests.statement: g = e^{4t}dt^2 on R, h = 4g, V = delta_{(0,1)}, X = (1-t^2)^2 on [-1,1]: Christoffel symbol 2, delta_g V(X) = 2, delta_h V^h(X) = 4, difference 2 > k|c^k - 1| sup|X'| = 8/(3 sqrt 3); the derivative-only bound fails off the flat metric.

layers.title: Smooth submanifolds and embedded ambient manifolds

targets.name: Varifolds.firstVariation_submanifold
targets.statement: For a C^2 embedded k-submanifold Sigma closed in W with locally finite area, with B(X,Y) = (nabla_X Y)^perp on C^1 tangent fields and H_Sigma = (1/k) tr B (this roadmap's convention for C^2 Sigma; R5a's B and R5a.2's H for smooth Sigma), delta[Sigma](X) = -k integral <H_Sigma,X> dH^k; [Sigma] is stationary iff H_Sigma = 0; agrees with R5a.2's first volume variation for smooth Sigma.
hypotheses: Sigma C^2 embedded, closed in W, locally finite area

tests.name: unit sphere
tests.statement: H_{[S^k]} = -k x; both sides give k H^k(S^k) for X = psi x.

tests.name: great sphere
tests.statement: a great k-sphere of S^N is stationary.

tests.name: half hyperplane
tests.statement: minimal but not closed in R^N: sigma != 0.

tests.name: top dimension
tests.statement: [W] is stationary for k = N.

tests.name: C2 graph
tests.statement: graph of |t|^{5/2} over (-1,1): C^2, not smooth, B(tau,tau) = u''(1+u'^2)^{-3/2} nu continuous; for X = phi(y_1)chi(y_2)e_2 both sides equal -integral phi u''(1+u'^2)^{-3/2} dt.

targets.name: Varifolds.firstVariation_inclusion
targets.statement: For M subset R^L embedded with second fundamental form B_M, W open in M closed in U open in R^L: delta(iota_# V)(X) = deltaV(X^T) - integral <X, tr_S B_M> dV; locally bounded first variation transfers both ways, H_{iota_# V} = H_V + integral tr_S B_M d nu^x, sigma and eta unchanged; rectifiability, integrality and densities preserved.
hypotheses: M smooth embedded in R^L with induced metric
U open, U cap M = W, W closed in U

tests.name: great sphere
tests.statement: a great k-sphere in S^N has H_{iota_#} = -k x.

tests.name: affine M
tests.statement: B_M = 0 gives delta(iota_# V)(X) = deltaV(X^T).

tests.name: zero
tests.statement: V = 0 and k = 0 give 0 = 0.

targets.name: Varifolds.monotonicity_identity
targets.statement: For V of locally bounded first variation in W subset E, x in W, 0 < sigma < rho < rho_0 <= dist(x, E minus W): rho^{-k}||V||(B_rho) - sigma^{-k}||V||(B_sigma) = integral over the annulus of r^{-k-2}|P_{S perp}(y-x)|^2 dV - integral_sigma^rho t^{-k-1} deltaV(1_{B_t}(y-x)) dt; with ||deltaV|| <= Lambda||V|| on balls, e^{Lambda rho} rho^{-k}||V||(B_rho) is non-decreasing; stationary identity and weighted identity.

tests.name: tilted line
tests.statement: for y_2 = a, both sides equal 2 sqrt(rho^2 - a^2)/rho.

tests.name: circle
tests.statement: for the unit circle at 0: 2 pi/rho = 2 pi - 2 pi(1 - 1/rho); a plus sign fails.

tests.name: plane
tests.statement: a plane through x has constant ratio omega_k times multiplicity.

targets.name: Varifolds.monotonicity_riemannian
targets.statement: For V of locally bounded first variation in W subset M, x in W, kappa >= 0, B_{rho_0}(x) a normal ball in W with sectional curvature <= kappa and sqrt(kappa) rho_0 <= pi/2: sigma^{-k}||V||(Bbar_sigma) <= rho^{-k}||V||(Bbar_rho) + integral_sigma^rho t^{-k}(||deltaV||(Bbar_t) + k sqrt(kappa) ||V||(Bbar_t)) dt; with a ratio bound Lambda, e^{(Lambda + k sqrt kappa) rho} rho^{-k} ||V||(Bbar_rho) is non-decreasing.

locator.where: Lemma 2.7 line 823-854; Lemma 3.3 line 1120-1127; Remark 3.4 line 1184-1203

tests.name: flat
tests.statement: kappa = 0, M = E gives 6.1's inequality without the |P_perp|^2 term.

tests.name: great circle
tests.statement: on S^2 a great circle has constant ratio 2; (1 - x cot x)/x = 2/pi at pi/2.

tests.name: radius bound
tests.statement: at sqrt(kappa) r = pi the comparison factor is -inf.

targets.name: Varifolds.density
targets.statement: Theta^k(mu,x) = lim mu(B_rho(x))/(omega_k rho^k); for locally bounded first variation it exists wherever the ratio bound ||deltaV||(B_rho(x)) <= Lambda||V||(B_rho(x)) holds for small rho, everywhere under bounded mean curvature without boundary, and ||V||-a.e. (in E the ratio bound holds a.e.; on M the geodesic ratio bound holds a.e. where Theta > 0, existence a.e. by chart balls and 6.2); it is measurable, upper semicontinuous in x and under convergence when ||deltaV|| <= Lambda||V||, and >= 1 on the support for rectifiable V with Theta >= 1 a.e.
hypotheses: V locally bounded first variation in W

api.name: existence
api.statement: exists where the first-variation ratio is bounded; a.e. in general (on M by chart-ball Besicovitch and 6.2, without a geodesic ratio bound); on M the geodesic ratio bound holds a.e. at points of positive density.

api.name: measurability
api.statement: Theta is ||V||-measurable.

api.name: usc in x
api.statement: Theta(x) >= lim sup Theta(y) under ||deltaV|| <= Lambda ||V||.

api.name: usc under convergence
api.statement: Theta(V,x) >= lim sup Theta(V_j,x_j) under uniform Lambda.

api.name: lower bound
api.statement: Theta >= 1 on spt for rectifiable V with Theta >= 1 a.e.

tests.name: circle
tests.statement: Theta = 1 on the circle, 0 elsewhere.

tests.name: crossing lines
tests.statement: Theta(0) = 2, nearby 1: not lower semicontinuous.

tests.name: step multiplicity
tests.statement: without sigma_V = 0 usc fails: Theta(0) = 3/2 < 2.

tests.name: half multiplicity
tests.statement: v(L,1/2) has Theta = 1/2.

tests.name: null point of density zero
tests.statement: v(L, e^{-1/|t|}): ||deltaV||(B_rho(0)) = 2e^{-1/rho}, ||V||(B_rho(0)) <= 2 rho^2 e^{-1/rho}, ratio >= rho^{-2} at the null point 0 where Theta = 0 exists; doubling ratio >= (2r)^{-1} e^{1/(3r)} unbounded.

targets.name: Varifolds.constancy
targets.statement: If V is stationary in W and spt||V|| subset Sigma, a connected C^2 embedded k-submanifold of W, then either V = 0, or Sigma is closed in W with H^k(Sigma cap K) < inf for every compact K subset W (so [Sigma] is defined) and V = theta_0 [Sigma] for a constant theta_0 > 0.

tests.name: line
tests.statement: v(L,3) has theta_0 = 3.

tests.name: disconnected
tests.statement: two parallel lines with multiplicities 1 and 2 are stationary: connectedness is needed.

tests.name: top dimension
tests.statement: stationary N-varifolds on connected W are multiples of the volume.

tests.name: non-closed curve
tests.statement: the graph of sin(1/t) over (0,1) is connected, C^2 embedded, of infinite length in the closed ball of radius 2 and not closed; only V = 0 is stationary with support in it, the first alternative.

tests.name: nonconstant volume density
tests.statement: on R with g = e^{2t}dt^2, V = [R] is stationary (deltaV(X) = integral of (e^t X)' dt = 0) with coordinate multiplicity 1, while 1 times the volume density e^t is not constant: constancy concerns the coordinate multiplicity.

targets.name: Varifolds.spt_subset_convexHull
targets.statement: If V on E has compact support and is stationary in E minus K for compact K, then spt||V|| lies in the convex hull of K; for K empty, V = 0.
hypotheses: V stationary in E minus K

tests.name: segment
tests.statement: a segment is stationary off its endpoints and lies in their hull.

tests.name: circle
tests.statement: the unit circle is not stationary off {0}; the conclusion fails accordingly.

tests.name: Dirac
tests.statement: delta_{(0,P)} is stationary off {0} and lies in {0}.

targets.name: Varifolds.density_ge_one_of_tendsto
targets.statement: For metrics g_i -> g in C^2 on compacts and varifolds V_i -> V with lim inf ||delta_{g_i}V_i||(U) finite and Theta_{g_i} >= 1 outside sets of vanishing mass: V has locally bounded first variation, ||delta V||(U) <= lim inf, and Theta_g(||V||,.) >= 1 a.e.
hypotheses: g_i -> g in C^2 on compact sets
density bound outside B_i with ||V_i||(B_i cap K) -> 0

tests.name: half-density segments
tests.statement: i segments of length 1/(2i): Theta = 1, ||deltaV_i|| = 2i -> inf, limit density 1/2.

tests.name: constant half
tests.statement: 1/2 v(L,1) shows the density hypothesis is necessary.

tests.name: varying metrics
tests.statement: (1+1/i)^2 e lines converge to the Euclidean line with Theta = 1.

targets.name: Varifolds.Varifold.varTan
targets.statement: For x with Theta^k(||V||,x) finite and rho^{1-k}||deltaV||(B_rho(x)) -> 0, VarTan(V,x) is the nonempty compact set of limits of V_{x,lambda_j}; each is stationary in (T_xM,g_x) with dilation-invariant weight of ball mass Theta omega_k rho^k.
hypotheses: V of locally bounded first variation near x

api.name: nonempty compact
api.statement: VarTan(V,x) is nonempty and compact.

api.name: stationary
api.statement: each C is stationary in (T_xM,g_x).

api.name: weight
api.statement: ||C||(B_rho(0)) = Theta omega_k rho^k and ||C||(lambda A) = lambda^k ||C||(A).

tests.name: two planes
tests.statement: VarTan = {V}, Theta = 2.

tests.name: triple junction
tests.statement: VarTan = {V}, Theta = 3/2.

tests.name: zero density
tests.statement: Lebesgue measure with a constant line has VarTan = {0}.

tests.name: great circle
tests.statement: on S^2, VarTan = {v(T_x C,1)}.

tests.name: ball masses
tests.statement: the measure with density 1 + (1/2) sin(log r) cos theta in dr dtheta on R^2 has mu(B_rho) = 2 pi rho but lambda^{-1} integral over B_lambda of cos theta is -pi/4 at lambda = 1 and pi/4 at lambda = e^pi: radial tests do not give dilation invariance of the weight.

targets.name: Varifolds.isRectifiable_of_density_pos
targets.statement: A varifold of locally bounded first variation in W subset M with Theta^k(||V||,x) > 0 for ||V||-a.e. x is rectifiable, V = v(Gamma, Theta).

tests.name: zero density
tests.statement: Lebesgue measure with a constant line is stationary, Theta = 0, not rectifiable.

tests.name: triple junction
tests.statement: rectifiable with theta = 1 off the junction.

tests.name: vertical lift
tests.statement: positive density but no locally bounded first variation, not rectifiable.

targets.name: Varifolds.compactness_rectifiable
targets.statement: For metrics g_i -> g in C^2 and any sequence of rectifiable V_i with locally bounded masses and first variations and Theta >= 1 outside vanishing sets, some subsequence V_{i_j} converges, and every subsequential limit V is rectifiable with locally bounded first variation, Theta >= 1 a.e., ||deltaV||(U) <= lim inf_j ||delta V_{i_j}||(U); stationarity passes to the limit.

tests.name: alternating lines
tests.statement: the lines y_2 = 0 (even i) and y_2 = 1 (odd i) satisfy the hypotheses, the full sequence does not converge (test integrals alternate 1, 0), and the even and odd subsequences converge.

tests.name: zigzags
tests.statement: zigzags of slopes +-1 and amplitude 1/i over [0,1]: ||deltaV_i|| = sqrt 2 (i - 1) + 2 (interior corners and the two endpoint atoms) -> inf; the limit with planes at +-45 degrees is not rectifiable.

tests.name: shrinking circles
tests.statement: masses 2 pi/i -> 0, limit 0.

tests.name: parallel lines
tests.statement: y_2 = 1/i converges to the x-axis.

targets.name: Varifolds.multiplicity_lemma
targets.statement: For delta in (0,1), Lambda >= 1 there is epsilon in (0, delta^2) such that every integral varifold W on B_3(0) for a metric h with ||h - e||_{C^2} < epsilon^2, ||W||(B_3(0)) <= Lambda, ||delta_h W||(B_3(0)) < epsilon^2 and tilt integral of ||P_S - p|| < epsilon^2 has, outside a set A of Lebesgue measure < delta, fibre density sums over the slab |q| < epsilon at most (1+delta)(omega_k 2^k)^{-1}||W||(B_2(x)) + delta. Simon's Lemma 42.9 is the case h = e; h != e is this roadmap's.
hypotheses: W integral on B_3(0) for h

tests.name: plane with multiplicity
tests.statement: m v(R^k x {0},1): fibre sum m <= (1+delta) m + delta.

tests.name: two sheets
tests.statement: two parallel planes at height +-epsilon/2: fibre sum 2.

tests.name: tilted plane
tests.statement: large tilt violates the hypotheses.

tests.name: parameter accounting
tests.statement: the Besicovitch bound on the exceptional set is c epsilon^{-1}(epsilon^2 + epsilon^2) = 2c epsilon; with unsquared thresholds it would be 2c and not small.

targets.name: Varifolds.compactness_integral
targets.statement: In 7.4, if the V_i are integral then every subsequential limit is integral.

tests.name: half multiplicity
tests.statement: 1/2 v(L,1) is rectifiable, not integral.

tests.name: half-density segments
tests.statement: limit 1/2 v(segment) not integral; first variations unbounded.

targets.name: Varifolds.varTan_isCone
targets.statement: If moreover rho^{-k}||V||({Theta < 1} cap B_rho(x)) -> 0, every C in VarTan(V,x) is rectifiable and invariant under all dilations about 0.

tests.name: cones
tests.statement: two planes and the triple junction are their own tangent cones.

tests.name: half multiplicity
tests.statement: 1/2 v(L,1) fails the hypothesis yet has a rectifiable cone tangent.

tests.name: step multiplicity
tests.statement: rho^{1-k}||deltaV||(B_rho(0)) = 1: 7.2's hypothesis fails.

targets.name: Varifolds.varTan_integral
targets.statement: For integral V of locally bounded first variation and x as in 7.2, every C in VarTan(V,x) is an integral stationary cone; for integral stationary V this holds at every point of W.

tests.name: smooth minimal surface
tests.statement: tangent cones are tangent planes with multiplicity 1.

tests.name: two planes
tests.statement: integral cone of density 2.

tests.name: quadratic cone
tests.statement: C_{p,q} is its own tangent cone at 0.

layers.title: Regular sets, invariance, currents and acceptance statements

targets.name: Varifolds.Varifold.regularSet
targets.statement: x in spt||V|| is C^r-regular if spt||V|| is a C^r embedded k-submanifold near x; reg^r V and sing^r V = spt minus reg^r V.

api.name: open/closed
api.statement: reg^r open in spt, sing^r closed in W; reg^inf subset reg^{r'} subset reg^r for r <= r'.

api.name: diffeomorphism invariance
api.statement: C^r diffeomorphisms map reg^r and sing^r to those of f_#V.

api.name: locality
api.statement: reg^r of a restriction is reg^r V cap W'.

api.name: constant multiplicity
api.statement: stationary V is a constant multiple of [spt] near points of reg^2.

tests.name: crossing lines
tests.statement: sing^r = {0} for all r.

tests.name: |t|^{3/2} graph
tests.statement: 0 in reg^1 minus reg^2.

tests.name: zero
tests.statement: V = 0 has empty reg and sing; 1/2 v(L,1) has reg = L.

tests.name: quadratic cone
tests.statement: sing^r C_{p,q} = {0}.

targets.name: Varifolds.locality_isometry_invariance
targets.statement: Every notion of Layers 1-8 commutes with restriction to open subsets and with push-forward by isometries of open sets onto open sets; Euclidean dilations preserve stationarity, rectifiability, integrality, regular sets, densities and varifold tangents and scale H, ||deltaV||, sigma.
hypotheses: f isometry of an open set onto an open set

tests.name: rotation
tests.statement: rotating crossing lines keeps Theta(0) = 2.

tests.name: restriction
tests.statement: restricting the circle to an arc keeps H and gives no boundary inside.

tests.name: dilation
tests.statement: dilated circle has |H| = lambda/R and density 1.

targets.name: Varifolds.auxiliaryVarifold_eq
targets.statement: For a locally integral k-current T with carrier Gamma_T and integer multiplicity theta_T, GeometricCurrents G6's auxiliary varifold is v(Gamma_T,|theta_T|) with weight ||T||; G6's first variation, density, monotonicity and tangent cones are those of this roadmap evaluated on it; local minimizers give stationary varifolds.
hypotheses: T locally integral k-current on W

tests.name: plane
tests.statement: oriented plane with multiplicity 2 gives v(P,2); orientation reversal gives the same.

tests.name: cancellation
tests.statement: [[P]] + (-[[P]]) = 0 has varifold 0, unlike v(P,1) + v(P,1).

tests.name: curve
tests.statement: a closed curve's varifold has H = curvature vector.

targets.name: Varifolds.acceptance_statements
targets.statement: Simon's theorem (warped metric g on R^{n+m+l}, smooth hypersurface Sigma with Sigma = reg^inf [Sigma] (Simon's convention) and [Sigma] stationary for g and sing^inf [Sigma] = {0} x {0} x K) and Edelen-Spolaor's theorem for n >= 8 (stationary integral varifolds converging to a multiplicity-one cone-singular varifold have at most one singular point of the same type in B_{1/2}) are statable in this roadmap's notions; they are not targets.
hypotheses: n >= 3, m >= 2, n+m >= 8, l >= 1, K closed (Simon)

locator.where: conventions line 77-83; Theorem 1.1 line 84-96; Theorem 3.7 line 432-441; EdelenSpolaor2023 Theorem 1.4 line 104-135

tests.name: notions defined
tests.statement: each notion used is defined in Layers 1-9.

tests.name: empty K
tests.statement: K empty gives sing^inf [Sigma] empty and, by the convention Sigma = reg^inf [Sigma], Sigma closed; the punctured hyperplane (R^8 x {0}) minus {0} in R^9 is stationary with empty singular set, not closed, and violates the convention.

tests.name: cone itself
tests.statement: V_i = V = v(C_{p,q},1) satisfies the second conclusion with y_i = 0.

Allard's regularity theorem, Euclidean and intrinsic Riemannian.
